title: TimeShop
description: A plugin to manage your time on the server! Change day and night. Flexible to settings. Set day or set night
body:
**TimeShop** — Buy Day or Night with In-Game Currency
TimeShop is a powerful and flexible Minecraft server plugin that allows players to change the time of day using in-game currency. It's perfect for economy-based servers, adding a new layer of interaction and strategy.

Key Features:
Buy Day and Night — players can purchase day or night by spending currency from your economy plugin (Vault).

Dynamic Pricing — the more often a player buys time, the higher the price becomes. The price increases automatically up to a configurable maximum.

Flexible Cooldowns — configure personal and global cooldowns between command usage.

Mob Clearing — after changing the time, you can automatically clear hostile mobs in the entire world, within a radius around the player, or around the spawn point.

![Mob Clearing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5650f14ccf46ceadafe9ff367e8841e8cf3d04b2.png)

Voting System — players can initiate a vote to change the time. The result is determined by the percentage of votes.

Statistics — track how many times each player has changed the time. Statistics are saved automatically.

![Statistics](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b9a3f38b3687876f5357ac6405f3cc12523fa00.png)

Multilingual Support — English, Ukrainian, Chinese, German and Spanish languages are supported. Each player can choose their preferred language.

![languages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe017a004494bb29f9be8312a9d866889800fbf3.png)

World Blacklist — disable time changes in specific dimensions (such as the Nether or the End).

Easy Configuration — all settings, prices, cooldowns, and messages can be modified in the configuration file without recompiling the plugin.


Commands:
/setday — buy day

/setnight — buy night

/vote <day/night> — vote for a time change

/timeshop reload — reload the configuration (admin)

/timeshop stats [player] — view statistics

/timeshop vote <day/night> — start a vote (admin)

/lang <en/uk> — change language

![comands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7601e829472d89b3ade368faa93fd0b5c228e3fe.png)

Requirements:
Vault — required for economy support

Economy Plugin — EssentialsX, CMI, XConomy, or any other Vault-compatible economy plugin
